_comment: Claude Code → OmniMind. PREFERRED: the hosted server with a personal omt_ token from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools: `claude mcp add --transport http omnimind https://omnimind-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer omt_…"` (add --scope user to make it available in every project; `claude mcp list` should report it connected). The JSON under mcpServers.omnimind is what that command produces. LEGACY (stdio, local checkout): mcpServers.omnimind-local runs the server in-process as agent claude-code-josh (josh-business, full write, sourceWeight 1.0) with an omk_ agent key from keygen; OMNIMIND_API_KEY is the shared service key; OMNIMIND_MCP_USER_ID is optional (user the omnimind:// resources read as). Server `instructions` load at session start and tell the model to call status_get / memory_search at the start of relevant turns — see docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8.
